column2: [title16][sentence]\nThe boat is 'docked' at the maintenance\nplatform.

[title29][sentence]
The fishing line has become hopelessly
tangled.  It looks like you aren't going to
be doing any fishing with this thing.
[title22][sentence]\nYou don't need to pull on the fishing\nline.  The boat is already here.
[title19][sentence]\nYou reel in the fishing line and\nstuff it in your pocket.

[title29][sentence]
As much as you would like to simply reach out and
just grab the boat, your arms simply aren't long enough.
Looking down, you see something large moving
in the water below and decide that trying to
swim to it could be a fatal mistake.

[title33][sentence]
Your little maneuver with the time bomb
has moistened the city a tad.  Only a single
building protrudes above the water
in the distance.  The boat you lowered is now
floating within reach of the platform.
[title25][sentence]\nThe [noun1] is uninteresting.
[title27][sentence]\nIt's a cliff.  It's in the sea.  O.K.?
[title27][sentence]\nIt's pretty.

[title26][sentence]
You can't help but wonder what kind of sick
society would pollute its own oceans.  You are also
surprised to see such a thing this far from
New Jersey.
[title11][sentence]\nYech!  Better not.
[title25][sentence]\nIt appears to be a naval proximity mine.  You'd\nbetter not get too close.
[title25][sentence]\nA fool and his torso are soon parted.
[title24][sentence]\nIt reminds you of your last blind date.
[title20][sentence]\nThe wicked witch hasn't melted--she's\nstill up there.
[title25][sentence]\nThere is a large open area to the south--probably\nworth exploring.
[title14][sentence]\nThey are uninteresting.

[title26][sentence]
You are still underwater.  To your west you see
a strange plant.  There is a large open area to the south.
[title10][sentence]\nIt's mostly sand.
[title21][sentence]\nYou have no interest in the coral.
[title27][sentence]\nYou really don't need it unless you're planning \non making some cheap jewelry.
[title25][sentence]\nYour heart pounds profusely over your\nfascination with . . . rocks?
[title25][sentence]\nYou do not need any rocks.
[title16][sentence]\nIt's not very interesting.

[title29][sentence]
Now that just might be a way out of here.
Of course there is the little matter of that
weird hungry purple thing.
[title30][sentence]\nThat funny purple thing came out of one of\nthese holes.
[title25][sentence]\nYou probably don't want to get\ntoo close to that thing.
[title25][sentence]\nNot much has changed since you last visited\nthe area.

[title29][sentence]
You are at the southeastern edge of the lagoon.
There is a cave here that could be a safe
exit from the water.

[title26][sentence]
Now that just might be a way out of here.
There is a dead creature lying next to it.
[title24][sentence]\nHe looks dead.  That burger must have been\nextremely toxic to make him ooze like that.
[title32][sentence]\nHe doesn't seem to interested in the burger.  Then\nagain, would you eat it?
[title27][sentence]\nThe air vent is just large enough for you to crawl through,\nbut it's being held closed by a small latch.
[title16][sentence]\nThat little scalpel did the trick.  The latch has\nbeen jimmied and the air vent is unlocked.
[title19][sentence]\nIt's a good thing you aren't too tired, because\nthe 'bed' looks extremely uncomfortable.

[title33][sentence]
Egad!  Look at all that stringy hair
clumped together in the drain.  It's 
just like your sink, except that there
isn't anything crawling around in it.

[title26][sentence]
Noticing that the seat is down you
quickly conclude that the last prisoner
must have been female.  You are
momentarily stunned by your own
brilliance.

[title29][sentence]
The cell is damp and dreary.  The bed looks
uncomfortable; calling the sink and toilet
"unclean" would be like calling Newton "bright".
To make matters worse, the force-field holding
you here is making your hair stand on end.

[title27][sentence]
The scalpel is a precision instrument.  Trying
to sharpen it without the correct equipment
is not a good idea.  You don't want to break
the thing--you may need it later.

[title29][sentence]
The back wall of this cell was obviously
carved from solid rock.  The other walls
are made of a strong ferrous metal.  The
only obvious means of egress is the front
of the cell, which is currently protected
by a powerful force field.

[title26][sentence]
Possibly the only thing in the room brighter
than yourself, the light bathes the room in
a sodium-orange glow.
[title26][sentence]\nYour walk is stopped short by a run-in with\nan impenetrable force field.

[title20][sentence]
You try once more to penetrate the
impenetrable force field, with predictable
results.
[title25][sentence]\nAfter bumping your face a third time you\ndecide to be more careful where you walk.
[title16][sentence]\nYou once more bash your face\non the force field.
[title32][sentence]\nNot right now!  Those guards might be watching!
[title25][sentence]\nDon't strain your eyes; there's really\nnot much to see.
[title13][sentence]\nNothing special here.
[title21][sentence]\nThey have been rocks for a long time.  They\nprobably will continue to be rocks for a long time.
[title26][sentence]\nSorry. Too heavy--not to mention useless.

[title25][sentence]
Millions of years ago these used to be rocks.  
Now look at them.  They have become, well, ahh,
older and wiser rocks.  Isn't it amazing what
evolution can do?
[title10][sentence]\nNot worth it.
[title25][sentence]\nCPR is definitely out of the question,  but maybe\nmouth to mouth might . . . nah.
[title26][sentence]\nYou carefully pick up the dead, slimy fish.
[title21][sentence]\nThat looks like an interesting area.
[title25][sentence]\nThere is a large open area north of you.
[title25][sentence]\nYou sense her presence as goose bumps \nencompass the pores of your body.

[title32][sentence]
You are toward the southern end of the lagoon.
A coral barrier blocks your progress south.  You
can swim north or east.
[title22][sentence]\nThe dense forest looks like the kind\nof place you would like to avoid.
[title20][sentence]\nIt's nice and straight.  You are glad to see that someone\naround here takes pride in their lawn.
[title21][sentence]\nNo doubt a sign that outsiders are not welcome.\nPerhaps you shouldn't hang around here too long.

[title21][sentence]
Yech! Whatever is cooking in that cauldron
smells bad enough to kill a horse.  Then again,
maybe that's what it's supposed to do.

[title30][sentence]
This appears to be some sort of native shaman's
home.  The fire under the cauldron has been recently
stoked--You may not want to hang around too long.
Then again, the door is open . . . .
[title16][sentence]\nThe path looks well used.
[title20][sentence]\nThe breathtaking mountains climb\nmajestically into the sky.
[title26][sentence]\nHow about that.  This plant actually grows on\na planet that has no cosmetics industry.
[title18][sentence]\nThe lawn is of little interest.

[title32][sentence]
This bird looks remarkably like what would be
called a vulture on your home planet.  Then again,
YOU have been called a vulture on your home
planet.
[title22][sentence]\nYou have a strange and eerie feeling that\nyou shouldn't be here.
[title19][sentence]\nThey are secured tightly to the pole and \ncan not be removed.
[title27][sentence]\nYou don't need it, your skin is in good shape.
[title17][sentence]\nThere are numerous insects crawling\naround the rocks.
[title21][sentence]\nYech!  Even if you could catch it you\ndon't need friends THAT badly.

[title26][sentence]
You have the same eerie feeling that you had when your
last girlfriend locked you in the closet for leaving the toilet
seat up.
[title20][sentence]\nThe cave ceiling is uninteresting.
[title16][sentence]\nWhen you've seen one rock, you've seen them all.
[title25][sentence]\nPerhaps they should be called 'enormous\nunliftable boulders'.  Get the point?
[title25][sentence]\nIt looks long and dark.  There appears to be a\nsmall glimmer of light at the far end.
[title22][sentence]\nThis is how you got here remember?
[title25][sentence]\nIsn't this the same type of growth that can be\nfound between your toes at the end of every month?

[title25][sentence]
These are not edible unless they're put on top of a
pizza.  Since nobody delivers in the immediate area,
they're useless.
[title20][sentence]\nImagine that, they still make cave floors\njust like they used to.
[title25][sentence]\nYou become very frightened until you \nrealize that it's just your reflection.
[title22][sentence]\nThis would appear to be the way out.

[title29][sentence]
You ponder how long it took
for these conical deposits to form.  You
also ponder what it would feel like to
trip and fall on one.
[title27][sentence]\nAs you can see, this is a bigger and more\nimproved version of the smaller stalagmites.
[title17][sentence]\nIt might be easier to rip an oak tree\nout of the ground.
[title18][sentence]\nThe field is basically grassy.
[title25][sentence]\nThe rocks here are not very interesting.
[title27][sentence]\nThese odd looking plants seem to\nbe common on this island.

[title27][sentence]
The sky is clear and blue.
You couldn't have asked for a
nicer day.
[title26][sentence]\nThe water, like the sky, is clear and blue.\nIn the distance, you can see a small island.
[title26][sentence]\nIt appears to be volcanic.  You can't make\nout any details from this far away.

[title21][sentence]
This meteorological monstrosity appears capable
of simultaneously reading the wind speed, barometric
pressure, relative humidity, your palm, and "Moby Dick".

[title19][sentence]
There are signs of heavy foot traffic 
between the weather station and that
strange booth.

[title26][sentence]
The purpose of this contraption completely
escapes you.  It appears to be a high-tech
porta-potty, you can't help feeling it must
serve some higher purpose.

[title25][sentence]
To the south you see the hut which that
large woman apparently lived in.  You can even smell it
from here.  Blech!
[title20][sentence]\nThis small peninsula seems to be used\nby someone for monitoring weather conditions.
[title24][sentence]\nThis is the booth that woman appeared and disappeared in.\nIt must be some sort of teleportation device.
[title22][sentence]\nThis is definitely a teleporter booth.

[title25]WRONG NUMBER
As the machine reduces you to a scarlet puddle you hear a
cold mechanical voice chanting: "We're sorry; your call cannot
be completed as dialed.  Please check the number and dial again."

[title22][sentence]
You probably shouldn't draw so much attention
to yourself.  You are not, after all, who she
thinks you are.

[title22][sentence]
You are standing in what appears to be a small
village.  There is only one person here, leaning
against a hut.
[title25][sentence]\nShe appears to be watching the chickens.
[title25][sentence]\nThe huts are well made grass and thatch huts.\nOne appears to double as a chicken coop.

[title22][sentence]
The chickens are running around in ignorant
bliss.  None of them seem to have
considered WHY they are being fed so well.

[title27][sentence]
Even if you could catch it you have no urge
to carry around something that is alive and kicking.
Never mind something that is clawing and pecking.
[title21][sentence]\nThe chicken looks like it has been slowly roasting\non that spit all morning.  It looks like it is just about done.
[title26][sentence]\nThis fire pit looks ideal for roasting fowl.
[title19][sentence]\nAre you nuts?  That would hurt!

[title27][sentence]
The stream looks cool and inviting.
Every now and then you see a large
dorsal fin glide by.

[title22][sentence]
On the opposite bank you see a path
leading through the trees.  The path 
looks overgrown, as if  no one had used
it in years.
[title21][sentence]\nThose little buggers would still be hungry if you\nfed them a herd of cattle.  Give it up.
[title19][sentence]\nThey look numerous and hungry.
[title17][sentence]\nThis is obviously where the twinkifruits\ncome from.
[title26][sentence]\nThe individual twinkifruits are not yet ripe, and\nthe bush is too big to carry around.
[title25][sentence]\nHmmmm.  Didn't you see those odd-looking\nfish in the stream?  You need to be more careful.
[title22][sentence]\nYou aren't currently of the correct gender for\nthat type of activity.
[title16][sentence]\nYou discover nothing new.

[title27]BINOCULARS
Taking your trusty binoculars off the hook reveals
a previously obscured portion of the poster.  You
spend a few moments studying it.

[title29][sentence]
You stare at the lamp...  You stare some more...
Realizing you may soon spend the rest of your life
wearing sunglasses and being led around by a dog
you decide to do something productive.

[title27][sentence]
Maybe if you stare at it long enough,
something really important will happen
that will help you escape from this planet - NOT!

[title17]LOOK THROUGH DOOR
The door leads back to the ship's
cockpit.  If you walk towards it
"real fast", it will open for you
automatically (honest it will).

[title19][sentence]
If you were to walk in that direction,
you would wind up in the ship's engineering
section, where you could check out the
damage to the hyperdrive firsthand.

[title24][sentence]
Being the man that you are you can't help
but to briefly pause and admire yourself in 
the medicine cabinet mirror.  You are elated 
to see that the hideous cold sore you "earned"
last month has finally cleared up.

[title27]MEDICINE CABINET
Well, let's see... you've got a couple of
old toothbrushes, a used up stick of deodorant
from last year you were saving "for an
emergency", and that festering pile of dried-up
toothpaste left over from when the 'Crust' tube
exploded a couple of years ago.

[title22][sentence]
The door creaks open once again, revealing
(once again) your sordid collection of
bathroom implements.

[title27][sentence]
The medicine cabinet door creaks shut,
and you remind yourself that one of these
days you're going to have to have that
toothpaste sandblasted off of the bottom
shelf.  For now, though, you decide to let
it ferment in peace.

[title27][sentence]
It's a cute little chair that you're
supposed to sit in while you eat dinner.
You never sit in it though, finding it
more convenient to drag a sandwich up
to the cockpit and get crumbs all jammed
in between the buttons on the console.

[title26][sentence]
Better not.  The many fluids that have been
spilled on this chair have formed a new adhesive.
You might never get up again.
